newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syrian paper condemns Netanyahu over Golan law.
newsitem.headline: Syrian paper condemns Netanyahu over Golan law.

text.p: An official Syrian newspaper on Thursday condemned Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, saying his support for a law that would make withdrawal from the Golan Heights difficult was a blow to peace.

"The Israeli prime minister went yesterday into an aggressive and very dangerous act when he directly interfered in the Knesset (parliament) to approve what they called the strengthening of the (annexation) law of the Golan," the ruling party daily al-Baath said.
"What Netanyahu and supporters did ... is a new aggressive act that is directly aimed at blowing any possibility to resume the talks on the Syrian-Israeli track," it added.
"It cuts the way short before any international attempt to restart the talks on the Syrian track from where they stopped."

Israel's parliament on Wednesday took a preliminary step towards passing a law that would make approval of territorial concessions on the Golan conditional on the support of at least 80 members of the 120-seat Knesset.
The legislation passed the first of three required readings by a vote of 43 to 40.
Sporadic Syrian-Israeli peace talks are deadlocked over withdrawal from the Golan Heights, captured by Israel in the 1967 Middle East war.
